user_prompt: We need to set up a comprehensive monitoring system for our workplace safety incidents and regulatory compliance across all our facilities. This should track hazardous events as they occur, evaluate our exposure to violations, and coordinate the necessary corrective actions. As we implement this, we also need to ensure our safety team can engage with relevant stakeholders in real-time across different communication channels to coordinate responses. Additionally, we'll need to make sure all hazardous materials data is properly managed and accessible so our sales and compliance teams can verify we're meeting all regulatory requirements when working with customers. Can you help us establish this integrated approach to safety management and compliance?
